chunks: As for what Yūnus narrated from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from al-ʿAlāʾ ibn al-Fuḍayl, who said:

Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “The legal punishment of the one who commits liwāṭ is like the legal punishment of the fornicator.” And he said: “If he is muḥṣan, he is stoned; otherwise, he is flogged.”

key_terms.أُحْصِنَ: being muḥṣan, legally fortified through marriage status
key_terms.الزَّانِي: the fornicator; one guilty of zinā

ai.seo_question: What is the hadd punishment for liwāṭ according to Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the hadd punishment for liwāṭ, equating it with the hadd of zinā. It distinguishes between the muḥṣan and non-muḥṣan offender, prescribing stoning for the former and flogging for the latter.
